subject: a flexible stone ribbon supporting one white orchid
art_direction: 灰石像丝带弯起托住一朵白兰，柔硬材质在桃灰背景中形成精巧不可能构造。
visible_description: 灰石像丝带弯起托住一朵白兰，柔硬材质在桃灰背景中形成精巧不可能构造。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create a flexible stone ribbon supporting one white orchid. Make the stone ribbon continuous, with sparse mineral veins following the curve. The orchid has one open bloom and a short stem, remaining clear above the loop. Use soft peach-gray background light and a grounded shadow. Focus detail at the stone bend and petal throat, avoiding extra plants or decorative props. Use naturalistic surreal sculpture painting. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
